title: Add Issue Priority Score Calculator Utility
description: Create a utility function in src/lib/priority-calculator.ts that calculates priority weight based on severity (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) and urgency. Add unit test in tests/unit/priority-calculator.test.ts.

title: Add Issue Export to JSON/CSV Formatter
description: Create a data export helper in src/lib/export-formatter.ts to export issues with their tags, assignees, and timestamps cleanly formatted. Add unit tests in tests/unit/export-formatter.test.ts.

title: Add SLA Breach Warning Buffer Helper
description: Add a helper function in src/lib/sla-warning.ts that flags issues approaching within 15% of SLA deadline. Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/unit/sla-warning.test.ts.

title: Add Markdown Comment Sanitizer & Parser Helper
description: Add a comment text helper in src/lib/comment-sanitizer.ts to detect and sanitize XSS or malicious tags in comment markdown. Add unit tests in tests/unit/comment-sanitizer.test.ts.
